retrieval-loop.title: Attempt, check, correct, return
retrieval-loop.summary: Closed-source retrieval and checked feedback serve different purposes.

nodes.label: Prompt
nodes.description: Choose a question matching the learning target.

nodes.label: Attempt
nodes.description: Produce an answer with the source closed.

nodes.label: Compare
nodes.description: Reopen the checked rule and identify gaps.

nodes.label: Repair
nodes.description: Explain the correction in your own words.

nodes.label: Later case
nodes.description: Return after a gap with a new comparable case.

steps.title: retrieve
steps.explanation: Choose a question matching the learning target. Produce an answer with the source closed.

steps.title: check
steps.explanation: Produce an answer with the source closed. Reopen the checked rule and identify gaps.

steps.title: correct
steps.explanation: Reopen the checked rule and identify gaps. Explain the correction in your own words.

steps.title: space
steps.explanation: Explain the correction in your own words. Return after a gap with a new comparable case.

spaced-returns.title: A realistic three-occasion plan
spaced-returns.summary: These dates are an adjustable example, not an optimum formula.

nodes.label: Tuesday
nodes.description: Introduce and attempt the rule for 12 minutes.

nodes.label: Thursday
nodes.description: Retrieve mixed cases for six minutes.

nodes.label: Monday
nodes.description: Use new cases after a gap.

nodes.label: Adjust
nodes.description: Use actual errors and availability to choose the next gap.

steps.title: two-day gap
steps.explanation: Introduce and attempt the rule for 12 minutes. Retrieve mixed cases for six minutes.

steps.title: four-day gap
steps.explanation: Retrieve mixed cases for six minutes. Use new cases after a gap.

steps.title: observe and adapt
steps.explanation: Use new cases after a gap. Use actual errors and availability to choose the next gap.

mix-related-cases.title: Choose the rule before the answer
mix-related-cases.summary: Urgency is an override in this synthetic policy.

nodes.label: Case
nodes.description: Read duration and whether it is urgent today.

nodes.label: Urgent
nodes.description: Urgent same-day requests go to a manager.

nodes.label: Long planned
nodes.description: Planned requests of two or more days go to a manager.

nodes.label: Short planned
nodes.description: Planned one-day requests go to the coordinator.

nodes.label: Check
nodes.description: State the case feature and compare with the source.

steps.title: urgent today
steps.explanation: Read duration and whether it is urgent today. Urgent same-day requests go to a manager.

steps.title: planned two or more days

steps.title: planned one day
steps.explanation: Read duration and whether it is urgent today. Planned one-day requests go to the coordinator.

steps.title: explain

steps.title: explain
steps.explanation: Planned one-day requests go to the coordinator. State the case feature and compare with the source.

feedback-action.title: Turn a comment into a repair
feedback-action.summary: Specific feedback names the decision that needs work.

nodes.label: Comment
nodes.description: Be more careful is too vague to act on.

nodes.label: Clarify
nodes.description: Ask which case, criterion and rule were missed.

nodes.label: Action
nodes.description: Add an urgency-first check to the decision.

nodes.label: Retry
nodes.description: Attempt a fresh urgent case without the answer visible.

steps.title: ask for detail
steps.explanation: Be more careful is too vague to act on. Ask which case, criterion and rule were missed.

steps.title: choose repair
steps.explanation: Ask which case, criterion and rule were missed. Add an urgency-first check to the decision.

steps.title: check revision
steps.explanation: Add an urgency-first check to the decision. Attempt a fresh urgent case without the answer visible.

transfer-cases.title: Transfer has a boundary
transfer-cases.summary: A shared decision structure does not make two policies identical.
